task: DATA is a list of text documents. Tokenize using only contiguous ASCII letters A-Z or a-z, and lowercase each token. Output exactly one JSON object with document_count, token_count, unique_tokens, frequencies (all lowercase token counts), and top_tokens (up to 3 objects with token and count). Rank by count descending, then token ascending for ties.

rules.token_count: Count all lowercase matches of [A-Za-z]+, including repeated tokens.
rules.unique_tokens: Count distinct lowercase tokens, not total occurrences.
rules.frequencies: Count every alphabetic token after lowercasing; punctuation is a separator.
rules.top_tokens: Rank by count descending and token ascending for ties; return at most three objects with token and count.

import re
from collections import Counter

def tokenize_and_count(documents):
    tokens = re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z]+', ' '.join(documents))
    tokens = [token.lower() for token in tokens]
    token_counts = Counter(tokens)
    document_count = len(documents)
    token_count = sum(token_counts.values())
    unique_tokens = len(token_counts)
    frequencies = {token: count for token, count in token_counts.items()}
    top_tokens = [{'token': token, 'count': count} for token, count in token_counts.most_common(3)]
    return {
        'document_count': document_count,
        'token_count': token_count,
        'unique_tokens': unique_tokens,
        'frequencies': frequencies,
        'top_tokens': top_tokens
    }

DATA = ["AI heals code. Code helps AI!", "Reliable code, reliable results.", "AI + tests = reliable code."]
result = tokenize_and_count(DATA)
print(json.dumps(result))
